school: 实测仪器主义（紫金山学派历算传统与工程水利传统的合流）
historical_significance: 郭守敬（1231-1316），字若思，顺德邢台人，元代天文学家、水利学家、数学家与仪器制造家——中国科学史上'仪器-观测-历算-水利'四位一体的集大成者。幼承祖父郭荣之学，从刘秉忠问学于紫金山；1262 年面陈水利六事而任提举诸路河渠，1264 年主持西夏治水，'因旧谋新、更立闸堰'，复通古渠十余条、支渠六十余条，灌田九万余顷；1276 年受命与王恂、许衡同修新历，提出'历之本在于测验，而测验之器莫先仪表'——创制简仪、高表、景符、仰仪、窥几等近二十种仪器，把八尺圭表加高为四丈高表并以小孔成像的景符取日心之影，测影精度提高一个量级；1279 年主持'四海测验'，'东至高丽，西极滇池，南逾朱崖，北尽铁勒'，设二十七所观测点——人类历史上第一次全国性科学联测；1280 年《授时历》成：回归年 365.2425 日与格里历同值而早三百年，废上元积年、截取近元，创三次内插（招差法）与弧矢割圆术（中国球面三角之始），施行三百六十四年为中国历法之最；1291 年复任都水监主持通惠河——引白浮泉西折绕瓮山泊入城，解决大都水源，设闸坝二十四座分级行船，江南漕船直入积水潭；又'尝以海面较京师至汴梁地形高下之差'——世界测量史上最早的高程基准记载，'海拔'概念的先声；晚年主持铁幡竿渠，施工者擅改其设计，渠为大水冲毁；1316 年卒于任上，年八十六；1970 年月球环形山、1977 年 2012 号小行星以其命名，汤若望称他为'中国的第谷'。
historical_significance_en: Guo Shoujing (1231-1316), courtesy name Ruosi, of Xingtai, was an astronomer, hydraulic engineer, mathematician and instrument-maker of the Yuan — the great integrator of instrument, observation, calculation and waterworks in Chinese science history. Schooled first by his grandfather Guo Rong, then by Liu Bingzhong at Zijinshan, he laid six waterworks proposals before Kublai Khan in 1262 and became Commissioner of Canals; in 1264 he directed the Tangut water restoration, 'renewing along the old lines and setting new sluices', reviving a dozen ancient canals and sixty-eight branches, irrigating over ninety thousand hectares; charged in 1276, with Wang Xun and Xu Heng, to reform the calendar, he advanced 'the root of the calendar is in measurement, and no tool precedes gnomon and sphere' — building nearly twenty instruments including the abridged armilla, the four-zhang high gnomon and the pinhole shadow-definer that takes the sun's centre, raising shadow precision an order of magnitude; in 1279 he directed the Four Seas Survey — 'east to Koryo, west to Dianchi, south past the red cliffs, north to the Iron Le' — twenty-seven stations, history's first nationwide scientific campaign; in 1280 the Shoushi calendar was completed: tropical year 365.2425 days, the Gregorian value three centuries early, the grand epoch abolished for a recent one, with his cubic interpolation (recruitment of differences) and the arc-sagitta conversion (the dawn of Chinese spherical trigonometry); it ran 364 years, the longest of any Chinese calendar; in 1291 he returned as Director of Waterways and built the Tonghui Canal — leading the Baifu spring west around Kunming Lake into the capital, twenty-four gates tiering the fall, southern barges sailing into Jishuitan; and he 'once compared the height-difference between the capital and Bianliang against the sea surface' — the first recorded height datum in the history of surveying, forerunner of the concept of altitude; in old age the builders of the Tiebanquan channel altered his design and the flood took the works; he died in office in 1316, aged eighty-six; a lunar crater (1970) and asteroid 2012 (1977) bear his name, and the Jesuit Johann Adam Schall called him 'the Tycho of China'.
unique_thinking: 把'精度'当作一条贯穿一切的因果链：仪器的精度决定观测的精度，观测的精度决定历法的精度，而这一切的起点是'历之本在于测验'——他不与旧学问辩论，他造新仪器；他不推倒旧渠道，他在旧渠口装新闸坝；他不驳斥幽灵前提（上元积年），他删掉它再跑一遍；他不与落差搏斗，他给落差装上二十四只手柄；他不裁决大都与汴梁谁高，他把海面请来当第三者——郭守敬的方法论一生只做一件事：为每一个争论找到一个比争论更硬的东西——仪器、数据、结构、基准
unique_thinking_en: Treating 'precision' as one causal thread running through everything: the instrument's precision decides the observation's, the observation's the calendar's — and the thread's beginning is 'the root of the calendar is in measurement'. He does not debate the old learning; he builds new instruments. He does not demolish old canals; he fits new gates to their heads. He does not refute the ghost premise (the grand epoch); he deletes it and runs the system again. He does not fight the gradient; he fits it with twenty-four handles. He does not judge which of Dadu and Bianliang stands higher; he invites the sea to be their third party — Guo Shoujing's methodology does one thing all its life: find, for every dispute, something harder than the dispute — an instrument, a datum, a structure, a reference frame.
civilization_zh: 元代的天文历法与水利现场：1231年生于邢州邢台（今河北邢台）——祖父郭荣精于五经、算数与水利，郭守敬幼承家学，又从刘秉忠（紫金山学派）问学，同门有王恂；十五六岁时得《莲花漏》图，'已能尽究其理'，依图以竹篾扎制浑仪并堆土台观测——1262年经张文谦推荐面见忽必烈，面陈水利六事，即被任命为提举诸路河渠；1264年随张文谦赴西夏，'因旧谋新、更立闸堰'，修复唐徕、汉延等古渠十余条、支渠六十余条，灌田九万余顷；此后查勘黄河河套、主持重开金口河（预开减水口以避洪，使用近三十年）；1276年受命与王恂、许衡等同修新历，提出'历之本在于测验，而测验之器莫先仪表'——先后创制简仪、高表、景符、仰仪、窥几、候极仪、玲珑仪、正方案等近二十种仪器；1279年主持'四海测验'——'东至高丽，西极滇池，南逾朱崖，北尽铁勒，四海测验，凡二十七所'，登封观星台与'量天尺'至今犹存；1280年《授时历》成，1281年颁行——回归年365.2425日，与格里历同值而早三百年，废上元积年、创三次内插（招差法）与弧矢割圆术，施行三百六十余年为中国历法之最；1291年复任都水监，主持通惠河——引白浮泉水西折绕瓮山泊入城，解决大都水源，设闸坝斗门二十四座以节水位，江南漕船直入积水潭；又曾'以海面较京师至汴梁地形高下'——世界史上最早的海拔概念；晚年主持铁幡竿渠，施工者擅改其设计，渠为大水冲毁——'郭太史不可及'之叹由此而来；1316年卒于任上，享年八十六；1970年月球背面环形山、1977年2012号小行星以他命名，汤若望称他为'中国的第谷'——中国科学史上'仪器-观测-历算-水利'四位一体的集大成者
civilization_en: The astronomical-calendrical and hydraulic scene of the Yuan dynasty: born in 1231 at Xingtai in Xingzhou (today's Hebei) — his grandfather Guo Rong was versed in the classics, mathematics and waterworks, and the boy learned first from him, then from Liu Bingzhong (the Zijinshan school), with Wang Xun a fellow student; at fifteen or sixteen he obtained a diagram of the 'lotus-flower clepsydra' and 'had fully exhausted its principle', building from bamboo strips a gnomon ring and an earthen platform for observing; in 1262, recommended by Zhang Wenqian, he stood before Kublai Khan and laid out six proposals for waterworks, and was at once made Commissioner of Canals for all circuits; in 1264 he went with Zhang Wenqian to the Tangut lands, 'renewing along the old lines and setting new sluices', restoring the Tanglai, Hanyan and a dozen more ancient canals with sixty-odd branch channels, irrigating over ninety thousand hectares; thereafter he surveyed the Ordos reaches of the Yellow River and reopened the Jinzhou Canal — with a pre-cut spillway to avert floods, it served nearly thirty years; in 1276 he was charged, with Wang Xun and Xu Heng, to make a new calendar, advancing the principle that 'the root of the calendar is in measurement, and for measurement no tool comes before gnomon and sphere' — he built or rebuilt nearly twenty instruments, among them the abridged armilla, the high gnomon, the shadow-definer (jingfu), the horizon bowl-dial, the star-peeker, the pole-observer, the lattice instrument and the orientation board; in 1279 he directed the 'Survey of the Four Seas' — 'east to Koryo, west to the Dianchi lake, south past the red cliffs of Hainan, north to the Iron Le', at twenty-seven stations; the gnomon tower at Dengfeng with its 'sky-measuring scale' stands to this day; in 1280 the Shoushi calendar was completed, promulgated in 1281 — the tropical year at 365.2425 days, the same value as the Gregorian reform three centuries later, discarding the fictitious 'grand epoch', inventing cubic interpolation and the arc-sagitta conversion; it ran for more than 360 years, the longest-lived of Chinese calendars; in 1291 he returned as Director of Waterways and built the Tonghui Canal — leading the Baifu spring west around Kunming Lake into the capital, solving Dadu's water supply, with twenty-four gates and weirs to hold the level, so that grain barges from the south sailed straight into Jishuitan; and he once 'compared the levels of the capital and Bianliang against the sea surface' — the earliest recorded sea-level datum, the concept of altitude above sea level; in old age he directed the Tiebanquan channel at Shangdu: the builders altered his design, and the flood destroyed the channel — hence the saying that 'Master Guo is not to be matched'; he died in office in 1316, aged eighty-six; a lunar crater (1970) and asteroid 2012 (1977) bear his name, and Johann Schreck's successor-eulogist Johann Adam Schall called him 'the Tycho of China' — the great integrator of instrument, observation, calculation and waterworks in Chinese science history.

modes.name_en: The Method of Measurement as the Root of the Calendar
modes.domain_zh: 历法方法论/把'历法之争'还原为'测验之争'：历代改历在数理推演里兜圈子，郭守敬一句话定调——'历之本在于测验，而测验之器莫先仪表'：先造仪器、先做观测，推算只是对观测的整理；他不与旧历家辩论旧数的好坏，而是让新仪器产出旧仪器根本产不出的数据，旧数在新数据面前自动作废——问题的层次决定了答案的层次，把问题下移一层（从'怎么算'移到'怎么测'），上层的争论自然消解
modes.domain_en: Calendrical methodology / reducing 'calendar disputes' to 'measurement disputes': generations of calendar reformers circled in mathematical derivation, but Guo Shoujing set the tone in one sentence — 'the root of the calendar is in measurement, and for measurement no tool comes before gnomon and sphere': build the instruments first, observe first; computation is only the organisation of observation. He did not debate the old numerologists on the quality of their numbers — he let the new instruments produce data the old ones could not produce at all, and the old numbers fell obsolete before the new data of themselves. The level of a question decides the level of its answer: move the question down one level (from 'how to compute' to 'how to measure') and the dispute above dissolves on its own
modes.definition_zh: 历法方法论/1276 年受命改历时的中国历法界，数百年间累积了十几部历、上百个争论焦点——上元积年怎么设、闰周怎么排、日法取什么分数，每一个都是可以在纸面上无穷纠缠的问题；郭守敬的贡献不在于逐一回答，而在于改写问题本身：'历之本在于测验'——历法的根本不在推演而在观测，不在数字而在产生数字的仪器；这一句话把整场争论从'谁的数学更巧'移到'谁的仪器更精'，而后者是可以分胜负的：四丈高表配景符把测影精度提高一个量级，简仪把赤经测定精度远超宋代浑仪——旧历的数字错误不需要被驳倒，只需要被更准的观测作废；方法论上这是'问题层级工程'：遇到上层的争议，先判断它是观测不足的伪问题还是原理缺陷的真问题——观测不足的，造仪器去解决，不去辩论；方法论上要求：把'数据质量'置于'推理技巧'之前，把争议转写为可测量的差异，用新产出的数据而非新的论证去终结旧争论
modes.definition_en: Calendrical methodology / the China of 1276 inherited a dozen calendars and a hundred disputed points from centuries of practice — how to set the grand epoch, how to arrange the intercalary cycle, what fraction to take as the day-constant, each an issue that could be entangled on paper forever; Guo Shoujing's contribution was not to answer them one by one but to rewrite the question itself: 'the root of the calendar is in measurement' — the calendar's foundation lies not in derivation but in observation, not in numbers but in the instruments that make numbers. That single sentence moved the whole dispute from 'whose mathematics is cleverer' to 'whose instruments are finer', and the latter can be decided: the four-zhang gnomon with its shadow-definer raised shadow-measurement by an order of magnitude, the abridged armilla took stellar right ascension far beyond the Song armillary — the old calendar's numerical errors did not need to be refuted, only made obsolete by finer observation. This is the engineering of question-levels: on meeting an upper-level dispute, first judge whether it is a false problem of insufficient observation or a true problem of principle — the former is solved by building instruments, not by debating; methodologically: rank data quality before inference skill, transcribe disputes into measurable differences, and close old arguments with newly produced data rather than new arguments
modes.source_chapter: 《元史·郭守敬传》：'历之本在于测验，而测验之器莫先仪表。'
modes.key_quote_zh: 历法的根本不在纸上，在仪器上——争论是测不够的产物，测够了，争论自己散场。
modes.key_quote_en: The root of the calendar is not on paper but in instruments — a dispute is the product of not having measured; measure enough, and the dispute adjourns itself.
key_concepts: 测验优先 measurement first（推演是对观测的整理而非替代——先回答'测得准吗'再回答'算得对吗'）
measurement first (derivation organises observation, never replaces it — answer 'is it measured truly' before 'is it computed rightly')
仪器先于数据 instruments before data（数据质量的上限由仪器决定——改进数据先改进产生数据的装置）
instruments before data (the ceiling of data quality is set by the instrument — to improve data, first improve the apparatus that makes it)
问题下移 question demotion（把上层的'怎么算'之争移到下层的'怎么测'——下层的胜负自动裁决上层）
question demotion (move the upper 'how to compute' dispute down to 'how to measure' — the lower level's verdict settles the upper)
作废而非驳倒 obsolescence over refutation（旧数据不需要被辩倒，只需要被更准的数据超越——让精度代替说服）
obsolescence over refutation (old data need not be out-argued, only surpassed by finer data — let precision do the persuading)
process_zh: 清点争议：列出当前争论的全部焦点，逐条分类——哪些是观测不足造成的伪争议，哪些是原理性真缺陷
下移问题：对伪争议不辩论，转写为'需要什么数据、需要什么精度的数据'的仪器问题
先造器后取数：投入仪器改进，直到新装置能产出旧装置根本产不出的数据
以新数废旧数：用新观测直接覆盖旧结论——不回手去批旧论证，只公开新数据及其产生方式
process_en: Inventory the disputes: list every contested point and classify — which are false controversies born of thin observation, which genuine defects of principle
Demote the question: for false controversies do not argue; rewrite them as instrument questions — what data, at what precision, is needed
Build before you measure: invest in instrument improvement until the new apparatus produces data the old could not produce at all
Retire old numbers with new: let fresh observation overwrite the old conclusions — never return to refute the old argument; publish the new data and how they were made
representative_cases_zh: 1276 年改历之初的定调：'历之本在于测验，而测验之器莫先仪表'——一句话把百年历争从数理推演移到仪器观测，随后简仪、高表、景符接连问世，旧历数据在三年内全部被重测覆盖
上元积年的废除：历代推算'上元'是为凑一个理想起点而做的数学迁就——郭守敬直接截取近代任意一年为历元，让'千古争论'被'不需要这个数'终结——不解决争议，而是取消争议的前提
四海测验：26 个测点（不计大都）的纬度与晷影实测——用横跨万里的数据一锤定音，而不是在都城用几份旧表来回辩论
representative_cases_en: Setting the tone at the calendar's opening (1276): 'the root of the calendar is in measurement, and no tool precedes gnomon and sphere' — one sentence moved a century of calendrical dispute from derivation to instrumentation; the abridged armilla, high gnomon and shadow-definer followed, and within three years every old datum had been re-observed

Abolishing the grand epoch: generations computed the mythical 'grand epoch' as a mathematical convenience — Guo simply took a recent year as epoch, letting the age-old dispute be closed not by resolution but by removing its premise
The Four Seas Survey: latitude and shadow measured at twenty-six stations beyond the capital — settled by data spanning ten thousand li, not by trading old tables back and forth in one city
modern_applications_zh: 产品技术路线之争的'数据下移'：A/B 方案争论不休时，先问'这个分歧能被什么实验数据裁决'——把设计辩论降级为实验设计
组织决策的'仪器先行'：会议反复争论的指标问题，往往是对抗性定义不清——先把测量口径钉死，争议常自动消失
研究与投资中的'精度替代说服'：遇到老观点，不写驳论文章，而是产出一份数据精度高一个量级的新研究——让旧文献自然过期
modern_applications_en: Data demotion in product-roadmap disputes: when options A/B deadlock, first ask 'what experimental data would adjudicate this split' — downgrade the design debate into an experiment design
Instruments first in organisational decisions: metrics argued over in meeting after meeting usually mask a contested definition — nail the measurement convention first and the dispute often vanishes

Precision instead of persuasion in research and investing: rather than write a rebuttal of an old view, produce a study one order of magnitude finer in its data — let the old literature lapse of itself

modes.name_en: The Method of Abridging the Rings
modes.domain_zh: 仪器制造方法论/创新不必是加新，更可以是减旧：传统浑仪层层嵌套七八个环圈，环环遮挡视线、累积读数误差——郭守敬把它拆散为简仪与仰仪，'简'字当头：去掉一切不直接服务于当前测量的部件，让每一个保留的环各自独立、各司其职——赤道环只管赤经，立运环只管地平，互不纠缠；一次大胆的减法让恒星赤经测定精度远超宋代浑仪，且成为后世赤道式装置的鼻祖——识别系统中的'仪式性部件'（因传统而在、因观测而不需要）并删去它们，是精度工程的第一杠杆
modes.domain_en: Instrument-making methodology / innovation need not add; it may subtract: the traditional armillary nested seven or eight rings, each occluding sight-lines and accumulating reading error — Guo broke it apart into the abridged armilla and the horizon bowl-dial, with 'abridged' as the watchword: remove every part not directly serving the measurement at hand, let each surviving ring stand independent and single-duty — the equatorial ring takes right ascension only, the altazimuth ring horizon coordinates only, neither entangling the other; one bold subtraction raised stellar right-ascension precision far beyond the Song armillary and founded the lineage of the equatorial mount — identifying the 'ceremonial components' of a system (present by tradition, unnecessary for the observation) and deleting them is the first lever of precision engineering
modes.definition_zh: 仪器制造方法论/浑仪自汉代定型以来近千年，环圈只增不减——每一个环都曾在某次测量中立过功，于是都成了'传统'的一部分；但环与环会互相遮挡：想测的星被挡住，读数要穿过三层环圈换算，误差是层层累积的；郭守敬的处理不是改良而是拆解——问'这次测量的本质是什么'，然后只保留回答该问题所必需的结构：测赤经赤纬的赤道式装置（简仪）与测地平坐标的立运仪分开，测日影的仰仪与测星星的窥几分开——'简仪'之'简'不是偷工，而是把'仪器的复杂度'从'传统的累积'改写为'测量的函数'；更深一层，去环之后每个部件的功能变得纯粹，误差不再互相感染，读数不再需要换算——这揭示了一个普适原理：系统误差往往不在部件不够好，而在部件之间不必要的耦合；方法论上要求：对任何成熟系统先做'部件问责'——每个部件为哪次测量服务？答不上来的就是仪式，仪式就是精度的敌人
modes.definition_en: Instrument-making methodology / for nearly a thousand years since its Han consolidation the armillary's rings only multiplied — each ring had once served some measurement, and so each became part of 'tradition'; but rings occlude one another: the star you want is blocked, a reading must be converted through three layers, and error accumulates layer by layer. Guo's move was not to improve but to dismantle — ask 'what is the essence of this measurement', and keep only the structure the question requires: the equatorial mount for right ascension and declination (the abridged armilla) separate from the altazimuth instrument, the horizon bowl-dial for the sun's shadow separate from the star-peeker; the 'abridged' in the name is not cutting corners — it rewrites 'a system's complexity' from 'the sediment of tradition' into 'a function of the measurement'. Deeper still: once the rings are gone each part's function becomes pure, errors no longer infect one another, readings no longer need conversion — revealing a universal principle: a system's error often lies not in parts being inadequate but in their unnecessary coupling. Methodologically: put any mature system through 'part accountability' — which measurement does each part serve? Whatever cannot answer is ceremony, and ceremony is the enemy of precision
modes.source_chapter: 《元史·天文志》载简仪形制：'其法：斂浑仪之环，别为简仪二……'；汤若望见简仪叹为'中国的第谷'之器
modes.key_quote_zh: 千年只加不减的环圈，是传统在替精度记账——把仪器的问题从'再加一环'换成'这环为何还在'，仪器就轻了。
modes.key_quote_en: Rings that a thousand years only added are tradition keeping the ledger at precision's expense — change the instrument's question from 'what ring to add' to 'why is this ring still here', and the instrument grows light.
key_concepts: 部件问责 part accountability（每个部件必须答出'为哪次测量服务'——答不出的是仪式性部件）
part accountability (every part must answer 'which measurement do I serve?' — whatever cannot answer is ceremonial)
减法创新 innovation by subtraction（删去仪式部件不是功能损失而是精度收益——复杂度是传统累积而非测量需要）
innovation by subtraction (removing ceremonial parts gains precision, not loses function — complexity is sedimented tradition, not measurement's need)
去耦合 decoupling（让每个保留部件功能纯粹、互不干扰——误差不再通过耦合传染，读数不再换算）
decoupling (each surviving part single-duty and non-interfering — error no longer spreads through coupling, readings need no conversion)
精度即纯度 precision as purity（测量的上限由'结构中非测量成分的占比'决定——越纯净越精确）
precision as purity (the measurement's ceiling is set by the share of non-measurement in the structure — the purer, the finer)
process_zh: 列全部件：把系统的全部部件列成清单——尤其是'从来就在'的那些
逐件问责：每个部件回答'它为哪次测量/哪个目标服务'——挂靠到具体用途，不许挂靠到传统
删除仪式件：答不出具体用途的部件一次删除——宁可删错再补，不可留错压精度
重测验证：删除后整体重测一遍精度——用数据确认减法是收益而非损失，再固化结构
process_en: List every part: inventory the system's components — above all those 'that were always there'
Hold each to account: every part answers 'which measurement or goal do I serve' — attached to a concrete use, never to tradition
Delete the ceremonial: whatever cannot name its use is removed in one stroke — better to delete in error and restore than keep in error and press down precision
Re-measure to verify: after deletion, re-measure the whole — let the data confirm the subtraction was a gain, then fix the new structure
representative_cases_zh: 简仪：把浑仪七八个嵌套环拆为独立的赤道式与地平式装置——观测视线再无遮挡，赤经测定精度远超宋代浑仪，成为后世赤道仪（含第谷、近代天文望远镜）装置结构的先声
仰仪与景符：不再给浑仪加环测日影，而是另造专门的仰仪（碗状日晷直接成像）与景符（小孔成像使影界清晰）——'测什么造什么'取代'一台仪器测一切'
高表：把八尺表加高到四丈并在顶架横梁，配合景符取日心之影——不是改良读数，而是改结构让误差源（影端模糊）从物理上消失
representative_cases_en: The abridged armilla: the nested rings of the armillary broken into independent equatorial and altazimuth mounts — sight-lines unoccluded, right-ascension precision far beyond the Song instrument, prefiguring the mounts of Tycho and the modern telescope

The horizon bowl-dial and shadow-definer: rather than add rings for solar shadow, he built dedicated instruments — the bowl-dial imaging the sun directly, the shadow-definer using pinhole projection to sharpen the shadow's edge — 'make what you measure' replacing 'one instrument for everything'

The high gnomon: raising the eight-chi gnomon to four zhang with a crossbar, paired with the shadow-definer to take the sun's centre — not better readings but a structure that removes the error source (the blurred shadow-tip) physically
modern_applications_zh: 产品与流程的'仪式审计'：成熟流程里必有大量'从来就在'的环节——逐项问责'为哪个目标服务'，删不掉的才留下
系统架构的解耦原则：误差与复杂度常来自组件间不必要耦合——让每个模块单一职责，测量（或监控）不再需要跨模块换算
指标体系的减法：仪表盘上几十个指标中，答不出'为哪个决策服务'的就是仪式指标——删掉它们，剩下的才有精度
modern_applications_en: Ceremony audits for products and processes: mature processes always carry steps 'that were always there' — hold each to account for its goal, keep only what survives the question

Decoupling in system architecture: error and complexity come from unnecessary coupling between components — single-duty modules mean measurements (or monitoring) no longer need cross-module conversion
Subtraction in metric systems: of the dozens of metrics on a dashboard, those that cannot name the decision they serve are ceremonial metrics — delete them and the rest gain precision
representative_figures: 郭守敬（核心）
第谷·布拉赫（平行参照：以大型赤道式仪器取代托勒密传统装置——同一场'去环'运动的欧洲版本）
威廉·奥卡姆（跨域参照：'如无必要勿增实体'——减法创新的哲学先声）

modes.name_en: The Method of the Tall Gnomon and the Shadow-Definer
modes.category: 工程方法论/误差源消除
modes.domain_zh: 精密测量方法论/不在读数端改进，而在误差源端消灭：圭表测影数百年，影端'半影'模糊是尽人皆知的误差——历代都在读数端想办法（更细的尺、更严的规矩），郭守敬反向操作：把表从八尺加高到四丈（误差相对缩小五倍），再用小孔成像的景符把'日边之影'变成'日心之影'（模糊的物理来源直接消失）——'把误差消灭在产生处'优先于'把误差修正在读数处'，是精密工程的第一分水岭
modes.domain_en: Precision-measurement methodology / do not improve at the reading end; extinguish at the error's source: for centuries the gnomon's shadow-tip penumbra was the notorious error, and every era tried harder at the reading end — finer scales, stricter rules; Guo operated in reverse: raise the gnomon from eight chi to four zhang (the relative error shrinks five-fold), then use the pinhole shadow-definer to turn 'the shadow of the sun's rim' into 'the shadow of the sun's centre' (the physical origin of the blur simply vanishes) — a hundredth finer at the reading end cannot match five-fold at the physical end. 'Extinguish error where it is born' over 'correct error where it is read' is the first watershed of precision engineering
modes.definition_zh: 精密测量方法论/测影的历史就是与半影搏斗的历史：太阳不是点光源，表竿的影子端部必然有一段模糊的半影——历代历家把这份模糊消化在读数习惯里（取中间、估分数），郭守敬则追问'模糊从哪里来'：来自日面有尺寸、表影够短；于是两个动作同时发生——把表加高到四丈让影长放大（同一份半影在更长影子中的相对占比缩小），再用景符的小孔成像让横梁的影像与日心重合（判定点从'影子到哪儿了'变成'孔像与横梁影重合的瞬间'，模糊的物理来源被绕开）；结果是一步到位：影长量到厘、时刻定到分以下，回归年长度 365.2425 日与真值差仅 26 秒；方法论要点有二：其一，'放大信号'优先于'细化读数'——信号放大后，原有读数精度自动升值；其二，'替换判定物理'优先于'优化判定算法'——当判定本身的物理是模糊的，再精细的算法都只是把模糊平均掉；方法论上要求：找到误差的物理出生地，先动它，再动测量链的其他环节
modes.definition_en: Precision-measurement methodology / the history of gnomon shadowing is a war against the penumbra: the sun is not a point source, so a rod's shadow must end in a blurred band — generations absorbed the blur into reading conventions (take the middle, estimate fractions); Guo asked instead 'where does the blur come from' — from the sun's disc having size and the shadow being short; two moves followed at once: raise the gnomon to four zhang so the shadow lengthens (the same penumbra shrinks in relative share), and use the shadow-definer's pinhole projection to align the crossbar's image with the sun's centre — the moment of judgment shifts from 'where does the shadow end' to 'when pinhole image and crossbar shadow coincide', bypassing the blur's physical origin; the result was one leap: shadow to the li, time to a fraction of a minute, the tropical year 365.2425 days within 26 seconds of truth; two methodological points: first, 'amplify the signal' outranks 'refine the reading' — once the signal is larger, existing reading precision appreciates automatically; second, 'replace the physics of judgment' outranks 'optimise the judgment algorithm' — when the act of judgment is itself physically blurred, however fine the algorithm it only averages the blur. Methodologically: find the physical birthplace of the error, act there first, then on the rest of the measurement chain
modes.source_chapter: 《元史·天文志》：'以铜为表，高三十六尺……又为二龙擎横梁……景符之制：以铜叶博二寸，长加博之二，中穿一窍，若芥子然。'
modes.key_quote_zh: 影子的模糊不是读数的问题，是太阳的问题——把表加高、让孔成像，模糊就退出了测量，而不是被平均掉。
modes.key_quote_en: The shadow's blur is not a reading problem but a solar one — raise the gnomon, let the pinhole image, and the blur exits the measurement instead of being averaged into it.
key_concepts: 误差源追溯 error-source tracing（先问模糊/偏差从物理上如何产生——出生地不动，下游全是涂改）
error-source tracing (first ask how the blur or bias physically arises — unless the birthplace is touched, downstream is all retouching)
信号放大优先 amplification before refinement（把信号做大，现有读数精度自动升值——放大五倍等于读数器升值五倍）
amplification before refinement (make the signal larger and existing reading precision appreciates — five-fold gain equals a five-fold finer reader)
替换判定物理 re-founding the act of judgment（当判定本身的物理是模糊的，换判定对象——从'影端'换成'孔像与梁影重合'）
re-founding the act of judgment (when judgment's own physics is blurred, change the object judged — from 'where the shadow ends' to 'when pinhole image meets crossbar shadow')
结构消误差 error removed by structure（最彻底的误差处理是让误差源在结构上不存在——优于一切下游补偿）
error removed by structure (the thorough fix makes the error source structurally absent — better than any downstream compensation)
process_zh: 给误差画像：把当前测量的主要误差列出来，逐个追问其物理/流程来源——不许把误差默认为'固有'
分类处理：物理可消除的走结构方案（改装置、改判定对象），只能缩小的走放大方案（加高信号、拉长时间）
先动源头：资源优先投向误差的出生地——读数端、算法端的改进排在结构改造之后
重定基准：源头消除后重新标定整套测量链——旧的'读数习惯补偿'（取中间、估分数）一并废除
process_en: Portrait the error: list the measurement's dominant errors and interrogate each one's physical/process origin — never accept an error as 'inherent' by default

Sort the treatment: physically removable errors go the structural route (change the apparatus, change the object judged); only-reducible errors go the amplification route (larger signal, longer baseline)
Touch the source first: resources go first to the error's birthplace — reading-end and algorithm-end refinements follow structural change
Re-baseline: once the source is extinguished, recalibrate the whole chain — the old 'reading-habit compensations' (midpoints, fraction estimates) are abolished with it
representative_cases_zh: 四丈高表：八尺改四丈——同一份半影在五倍影长中相对占比缩小五倍，登封观星台与'量天尺'至今犹存，是这一'放大信号'策略的实体纪念碑
景符小孔成像：铜叶穿芥子孔，日光过孔在圭面成像，横梁影与孔像重合处即日心——判定对象从模糊的'影端'换成清晰的'重合瞬间'，半影被物理绕开
授时历的回归年值：高表景符的测影精度直接兑现为 365.2425 日的回归年长度——与格里历同值而早三百年，与 1582 年西方实测差仅 26 秒
representative_cases_en: The four-zhang gnomon: eight chi raised to four zhang — the same penumbra shrinks five-fold in relative share of a shadow five times longer; the Dengfeng gnomon tower and its sky-measuring scale stand today as the physical monument to signal amplification

The shadow-definer's pinhole: a brass leaf pierced by a poppy-seed hole throws the sun's image on the scale; where the crossbar's shadow meets the image lies the sun's centre — the object judged shifts from a blurred 'shadow-tip' to a sharp 'moment of coincidence', the penumbra bypassed physically
The Shoushi tropical year: the precision of gnomon-and-definer cashed out directly as 365.2425 days — the Gregorian value, three centuries early, within 26 seconds of the 1582 Western determination
modern_applications_zh: 数据工程的'源头治理'：报表数字有偏，先查采集端（埋点、传感器、口径）再查计算端——读数端的四舍五入补不了采集端的物理模糊
实验设计的'信号放大'：效应太弱先加大基线/样本/时长，而不是先升级统计方法——放大后现有方法自动升值
质量管理的'结构消误差'：装配公差问题优先改夹具与定位结构，而不是培训工人'更仔细'——把误差从流程里拆掉优于把注意力压上去
modern_applications_en: Source governance in data engineering: when report numbers skew, audit the collection end (instrumentation, sensors, conventions) before the computation end — no rounding at the reading end can repay physical blur at collection
Signal amplification in experiment design: when the effect is weak, first widen the baseline/sample/duration rather than upgrading the statistics — amplification makes existing methods appreciate
Error removed by structure in quality management: fix jigs and datum structures before training workers to be 'more careful' — dismantling the error from the process beats pressing attention onto it

modes.name_en: The Method of Measuring the Four Seas as One
modes.category: 组织方法论/大规模并行观测
modes.domain_zh: 大科学组织方法论/一个真理问题可以拆成一场横跨万里的大规模并行作业：为编一历，设 27 个观测点——'东至高丽，西极滇池，南逾朱崖，北尽铁勒'——14 位天文官各携统一仪器、按统一口径同时观测，南北纬度差带来的晷影差与昼夜差同时到手；这不是巡视，是一场'把整个疆域当作实验装置'的组织工程：仪器标准化、口径统一化、数据集中化，三件缺一不可；单个观测点无意义的读数，在 27 点的网格里成为可解方程的系数——广度本身成为精度的一种来源
modes.domain_en: Big-science methodology / one truth-question can be decomposed into a massive parallel campaign spanning ten thousand li: for one calendar, twenty-seven stations — 'east to Koryo, west to Dianchi, south past the red cliffs, north to the Iron Le' — fourteen astronomers with standardised instruments under one convention observing in concert, so that shadow differences and day-length differences across latitudes arrived together; this was not a tour of inspection but an organisational engineering that 'makes the whole realm the experimental apparatus': standard instruments, one convention, centralised data — all three indispensable; readings meaningless at any single station became coefficients of a solvable system within the twenty-seven-station grid — breadth itself becomes a source of precision
modes.definition_zh: 大科学组织方法论/历法需要知道的是'天'，但天在每一个纬度都不一样——晷影的长短、昼夜的长短、节气的先后都是纬度的函数；郭守敬的洞见是：与其在都城猜一个'平均的天'，不如把'天'当作一个待解的场去全面采样——1279 年设 27 个观测点，统一仪器（都是他亲手设计的），统一观测量（晷影、昼夜刻、北极出地高度），统一时间窗（同一年内完成）；每个点的读数单独看只是地方志材料，但 27 点在纬度轴上排开就成了一个方程组：太阳的高度角模型、大气折射修正、大地本身的形状，都从这组网格数据中逼出来；这是人类历史上第一次把'一个科学问题'组织成'一场全国性并行实验'——比欧洲的大规模天文联测早了四个世纪；方法论上它给出大科学作业的三条铁律：仪器不统一则数据不可比，口径不统一则数据不可合，时间不同步则数据不可解；以及一个更深的原则：当问题在单点上无解时，把它升维成一场空间上的并行采样
modes.definition_en: Big-science methodology / what the calendar needs to know is 'the sky', yet the sky differs at every latitude — shadow length, day length, the order of solar terms are all functions of latitude; Guo's insight: rather than guess an 'average sky' from the capital, treat the sky as a field to be sampled comprehensively — in 1279, twenty-seven stations, uniform instruments (all of his own design), one observation protocol (shadow, day-and-night lengths, polar altitude), one time window (all within the same year); any single station's reading alone is gazetteer material, but twenty-seven stations spread along the latitude axis form a system of equations: the solar altitude model, refraction corrections, the shape of the earth itself are all forced out of the grid; this was the first time in human history a scientific question was organised as a nationwide parallel experiment — four centuries before Europe's coordinated campaigns. It gives three iron laws of big-science operations: without uniform instruments data are incomparable, without one convention they are incommensurable, without synchronised time insoluble — and a deeper principle: when a question is unsolvable at a single point, raise it into a spatial campaign of parallel sampling
modes.source_chapter: 《元史·郭守敬传》：'设监候官一十四员，分道而出，东至高丽，西极滇池，南逾朱崖，北尽铁勒，四海测验，凡二十七所。'
modes.key_quote_zh: 天不是一座城的天，是万里疆域的天——把疆域本身变成仪器，一个点读不懂的数，二十七个点联立就读懂了。
modes.key_quote_en: The sky is not one city's sky but a realm's sky spanning ten thousand li — make the realm itself the instrument, and a number no single point can read becomes legible when twenty-seven points are set side by side.
key_concepts: 疆域即装置 the realm as apparatus（把地理广度本身当作实验资源——采样网格的广度是精度的一种来源）
the realm as apparatus (geographic breadth itself as experimental resource — the grid's extent is a source of precision)
三统一三不可 three unities, three impossibilities（仪器不统一不可比、口径不统一不可合、时间不同步不可解）
three unities, three impossibilities (non-uniform instruments make data incomparable, non-uniform conventions incommensurable, unsynchronised time insoluble)
网格化求解 solving by grid（单点无意义的数据在网格里成为方程组的系数——让广度把单点噪声压成可解结构）
solving by grid (pointless readings become coefficients of an equation system within the grid — breadth presses single-point noise into solvable structure)
并行采场 parallel field-sampling（把'猜平均值'升级为'测场'——对空间分布的量不设代表点，设采样网）
parallel field-sampling (upgrade 'guessing the average' to 'measuring the field' — for spatially distributed quantities, no representative point, only a sampling net)
process_zh: 把问题场化：识别目标量是空间/时间的分布函数还是单点常数——分布函数不设代表点，直接设计采样网
统一三件事：仪器型号、观测口径、时间窗口——三者不统一，数据量再大也只是资料的堆积
平行投放：训练标准化的观测队伍分道而出——每个点执行完全相同的动作，差异只许来自世界，不许来自操作者
联立归算：把全网数据当一组方程解——用网格的冗余性交叉验证单点质量，个别坏点可被识别与剔除
process_en: Field-ise the question: identify whether the target quantity is a spatial/temporal distribution or a point constant — for distributions, no representative point; design a sampling net instead
Unify three things: instrument type, observation convention, time window — without these three, more data is only a pile of material
Deploy in parallel: train a standardised corps and send it out by routes — every station performs exactly the same act, and differences may come only from the world, never from the operator
Reduce jointly: treat the whole net as one system of equations — use the grid's redundancy to cross-check station quality, so bad points can be identified and cast out
representative_cases_zh: 1279 年四海测验：14 位监候官分道，27 个观测点统一测晷影与北极出地——'东至高丽，西极滇池，南逾朱崖，北尽铁勒'，人类史上第一次全国性科学联测，为授时历提供了横跨纬度的完整数据网
登封观星台：27 点网络的中心台站，高表与量天尺至今犹存——中心站与外站点同一仪器、同一口径，网格数据因此可归算
授时历的节气精度：全网晷影数据拟合出的太阳运动模型使节气测算与现代值仅差 2 分钟——广度换来的精度直接写进了历法
representative_cases_en: The Four Seas Survey of 1279: fourteen observers dispatched by routes, twenty-seven stations measuring shadow and polar altitude under one convention — 'east to Koryo, west to Dianchi, south past the red cliffs, north to the Iron Le', history's first nationwide scientific campaign, supplying the Shoushi calendar a latitude-spanning data net

The Dengfeng gnomon tower: the central station of the twenty-seven, its tall gnomon and measuring scale still standing — centre and outstations on identical instruments and one convention, which is why the grid could be reduced at all

The solar-term precision of the Shoushi: the solar-motion model fitted from the net's shadow data brings solar terms within two minutes of modern values — precision bought by breadth, written straight into the calendar
modern_applications_zh: 多地灰度/分布式 A/B 实验：把一次全国性发布组织成统一口径、统一时窗的并行采样——单城数据是噪声，多城联立才是结论
连锁组织的'三统一'巡检：门店诊断前先统一检测工具、诊断口径、时间窗——否则区域数据只是故事的集合
分布式科研/众包测量：公民科学项目的成败在'仪器与协议统一'而不在参与者数量——郭守敬 1279 年就是范例
modern_applications_en: Multi-region rollouts and distributed A/B tests: organise a national launch as parallel sampling under one convention and one time window — one city's data is noise; cities solved jointly are a conclusion

The three unities in chain-organisation audits: before diagnosing stores, unify the instruments, the diagnostic convention and the time window — otherwise regional data are only a collection of stories
Distributed science and crowdsourced measurement: citizen-science projects live or die on instrument-and-protocol uniformity, not headcount — Guo's campaign of 1279 is the standing exemplar

埃拉托色尼（承前参照：以两地晷影联立测地球周长——'网格化求解'的古代原型）
卡尔·林奈（跨域参照：以统一口径组织全球采集网络——标本事业的'三统一'版本）

modes.name_en: The Method of Abolishing the Grand Epoch
modes.domain_zh: 数理方法论/有些争论不能被解决，只能被取消——取消的方式是审计它的前提：历代历法都要推一个'上元'——一个假想的、日月合璧五星连珠的理想起点，从它累加到当今；这个'甲子、朔旦、冬至齐会'的上元是个数学幽灵，为凑齐它历代历家扭曲了基本常数；郭守敬直接废掉上元积年，'截取近元'：以实际观测的那一年为起点，从此不再需要那个幽灵——没用任何论证去驳'上元'，只是证明计算可以完全不需要它；识别系统中的'幽灵变量'（所有推导都依赖、但现实里并不存在的前提），并验证删去它之后系统照样运转，是方法论改革最干净的形式
modes.domain_en: Methodological reform / some disputes cannot be settled, only cancelled — and cancellation means auditing their premise: every calendar before his computed a 'grand epoch' — an ideal moment when sun, moon and the five planets stood in conjunction, to which all reckoning was accumulated; that epoch, the perfect meeting of jiazi, new moon and winter solstice, was a mathematical ghost, and generations bent their basic constants to force it; Guo abolished the grand epoch outright and 'took a recent epoch': the year of actual observation becomes the start — the ghost is no longer needed. He never argued the grand epoch down; he simply showed the computation does not need it at all. To identify a system's 'ghost variables' — premises every derivation leans on but that do not exist in reality — and to demonstrate the system runs fine without them, is the cleanest form of methodological reform
modes.definition_zh: 数理方法论/上元积年的逻辑是美学强加给数学的：古人相信'天地开辟'必有一个万事齐会的起点，于是历法必须从这个起点讲起——为了凑出'甲子朔旦冬至'同时成立的上元，历家在日法、闰周上不断让步，常数被幽灵绑架；郭守敬的动作是一次彻底的前提审计：问'如果取消上元，计算会失去什么'——答案是：什么都不失去，反而获得自由（截元之后，历法所用的一切数据都是当代实测，常数不再为远古背书）；授时历由此'不用积年，截取近元'，成为中国古代历法中唯一完全摆脱上元包袱的主流历法；方法论上要点有三：其一，区分'论证需要的前提'与'实在拥有的前提'——上元只在论证里存在，不在天上存在；其二，幽灵变量的检验方式不是辩论而是删除试验——删掉它跑一遍系统，跑得通它就是幽灵；其三，删幽灵的同时要把'被幽灵扭曲的下游常数'一并解放——废上元之后，日法、闰周全都回归观测本位；这套'前提审计-删除试验-下游解放'三步，是把一场千年争论变成一次内部清理的完整方法
modes.definition_en: Mathematical methodology / the grand epoch's logic was aesthetics imposed on mathematics: the ancients held that at creation all cycles must have met at one moment, so the calendar must narrate from that origin — and to force a jiazi-new-moon-solstice coincidence, calendarists conceded again and again on their day-constants and intercalary cycles, constants hostage to a ghost. Guo's move was a thorough premise audit: ask 'if the grand epoch is abolished, what does the computation lose?' — the answer: nothing, and it gains freedom (with a recent epoch, every datum the calendar uses is contemporary measurement; constants no longer vouch for antiquity). The Shoushi thus 'uses no accumulated epoch, taking a recent one' — the only mainstream Chinese calendar wholly free of the grand epoch's burden. Three methodological points: first, distinguish premises needed by the argument from premises possessed by reality — the grand epoch existed in arguments, not in the sky; second, the test of a ghost variable is not debate but the deletion trial — remove it, run the system; if it runs, it was a ghost; third, along with the ghost, liberate the downstream constants it had distorted — once the epoch is abolished, day-constants and intercalary cycles return to observational sovereignty. This 'premise audit, deletion trial, downstream liberation' triad is the complete method for turning a thousand-year dispute into an internal clean-up
modes.source_chapter: 《元史·历志》：'授时历……不用积年日法，上考往古，下验将来，皆随时推测。'
modes.key_quote_zh: 有些前提不需要被驳倒，只需要被删除——删掉之后系统照常运转的那个前提，本来就是幽灵。
modes.key_quote_en: Some premises need no refutation, only deletion — the premise after whose removal the system still runs was a ghost all along.
key_concepts: 前提审计 premise audit（区分'论证需要的前提'与'实在拥有的前提'——只在论证里存在的是幽灵）
premise audit (distinguish premises the argument needs from premises reality possesses — what exists only in arguments is a ghost)
删除试验 the deletion trial（检验幽灵的方式不是辩论而是删除后试运行——跑得通即幽灵成立）
the deletion trial (test a ghost by removal and trial run, not by debate — if the system runs, the ghost is confirmed)
截取近元 taking a recent epoch（让计算的起点回到观测的当下——数据本位对美学本位的胜利）
taking a recent epoch (return the computation's origin to the observational present — data-sovereignty defeating aesthetics-sovereignty)
下游解放 downstream liberation（删幽灵的同时解放被它扭曲的全部下游常数——不解放则幽灵阴魂不散）
downstream liberation (abolishing the ghost also frees every downstream constant it distorted — otherwise the ghost lingers)
process_zh: 画出依赖图：把系统推导所依赖的全部前提列成依赖图，标出哪些是实在的、哪些只是传统/美学要求的
选幽灵做删除试验：挑'最可疑且最便于试验'的前提，删掉它把系统完整跑一遍——成本必须可控
验证无损失：确认删除后输出质量不降反升（幽灵的存在本身常在持续制造扭曲）
一并解放下游：清除幽灵后，回头检查所有曾为幽灵让路的参数/流程，把它们回归本位
process_en: Draw the dependency graph: list every premise the system's derivations lean on; mark which are real and which exist only by tradition or aesthetics
Pick a ghost and run the deletion trial: choose the most suspect and most testable premise, remove it, and run the system end to end — the cost must be contained
Verify no loss: confirm output quality does not drop (a surviving ghost is usually distorting output all along, so quality often rises)
Liberate downstream together: after the ghost is gone, revisit every parameter and process that once yielded to it, restoring each to its observational purpose
representative_cases_zh: 废上元积年：授时历'不用积年，截取近元'——千年上元之争不辩而终，历法常数从'为远古背书'中解放，回归当代实测
常数随之回归：废元之后，日法采用百分制（一日分为万分），闰周不再强行凑整——被幽灵绑架的下游常数全部回归观测本位
历法寿命的印证：摆脱幽灵包袱的授时历施行 364 年，为中国历代之最——前提干净的系统能活得更久
representative_cases_en: Abolishing the grand epoch: the Shoushi 'uses no accumulated epoch, taking a recent one' — the millennium-old dispute closed without debate; the calendar's constants freed from vouching for antiquity return to contemporary measurement

Constants return home: with the epoch gone the day is divided into ten thousand parts and the intercalary cycle no longer forced round — every downstream constant once hostage to the ghost returns to observational sovereignty
Longevity as corroboration: freed of the ghost, the Shoushi ran 364 years, the longest of any Chinese calendar — systems with clean premises live longer
modern_applications_zh: 组织流程的'幽灵 KPI'审计：某些考核指标所有推导都依赖却无人能说出其现实依据——删掉试运行一个季度，流程不坏即为幽灵
工程系统的'历史包袱'清理：为兼容早已不存在的旧版本而保留的开关与分支——做一次'截取近元'，以当前版本为唯一起点
个人决策的'沉没前提'检验：'必须先完成 X 才能做 Y'之类前提做删除试验——很多'必须'删掉后人生照常运转
modern_applications_en: Ghost-KPI audits in organisations: some metrics every derivation leans on yet none can ground in reality — delete one and trial a quarter; if the process survives, it was a ghost
Clearing legacy baggage in engineering: switches and branches kept for old versions that no longer exist — perform a 'recent epoch' cut and make the current version the sole start
The sunk-premise test in personal decisions: trial-delete premises like 'must finish X before Y' — many a 'must' removed, life runs on unaffected
representative_figures: 郭守敬（核心）
哥白尼（平行参照：废除'恒星天/本轮'幽灵前提——同一'删除试验'在天文学另一端的执行）
奥卡姆的威廉（跨域参照：'勿增实体'——幽灵变量审计的哲学祖师）

modes.name_en: The Method of Interpolation and Arc-Sagitta Conversion
modes.domain_zh: 数学建模方法论/给不均匀的天行配一副可计算的数学骨架：天体运动不均匀，用一次插值必有系统残差——郭守敬与王恂创'招差法'（三次内插）：用三阶差分逼近太阳运动的逐日不均匀，使日行盈缩的计算残差降到古历的几分之一；又创'弧矢割圆术'，用沈括会圆术的思路把黄道度数与赤道度数互相换算——中国数学史上第一次球面三角的系统解法；其方法论内核是：观测精度提高之后，必须同步提高'数学骨架'的阶数——仪器升一级，算法必须跟着升一级，否则新数据被旧公式浪费；精度是仪器与算法的乘积，不是仪器单独的成绩
modes.domain_en: Mathematical-modelling methodology / fit a computable mathematical skeleton to the uneven motion of the heavens: celestial motion is non-uniform, and first-order interpolation leaves systematic residuals — Guo and Wang Xun invented the 'recruitment-of-differences' method (cubic interpolation): third-order differences approximate the sun's daily non-uniformity, cutting the residuals of the solar equation to a fraction of the old calendars'; and they devised the 'arc-sagitta' conversion, extending Shen Kuo's circle-dividing art to translate between ecliptic and equatorial degrees — the first systematic solution of spherical trigonometry in Chinese mathematics. Its methodological core: once observational precision rises, the order of the mathematical skeleton must rise in step — instruments up a level, algorithms must follow, or the new data are wasted by the old formulas; precision is the product of instrument and algorithm, not the instrument's achievement alone
modes.definition_zh: 数学建模方法论/测量与计算是一对必须同步升级的齿轮：高表景符把测影精度提高一个量级之后，如果仍用旧的平气平运动公式归算，新数据的潜力会被旧算法的天花板封顶——郭守敬团队的应对是数学本身的升级：其一，招差法（三次内插）用三阶差分刻画日行的不均匀——不是把不均匀'平均掉'，而是把它作为三阶结构精确刻画出来；其二，弧矢割圆术把'黄道弧'与'赤道弧'的换算变成可计算的代数——此前历家只能在两种坐标间做粗略映射，现在有了精确换算的算法骨架；这两项都达到当时世界数学的前沿（招差法早于牛顿的三次插值理论约四百年）；方法论要点有三：其一，'算法阶数'要与'数据质量'匹配——低阶算法处理高阶数据会系统性失真，高阶算法处理低阶数据则浪费；其二，新数学骨架的验收标准仍是观测——招差法的参数由实测日影定出，割圆术的系数由实测弧长定出，数学不为自己立法；其三，同步升级的观念：改历项目里'造仪器'与'造算法'是同一场战役的两条战线，不是先后关系
modes.definition_en: Mathematical-modelling methodology / measurement and computation are a pair of gears that must be upgraded in step: after the tall gnomon and shadow-definer raised shadow precision an order of magnitude, reducing with the old uniform-motion formulas would cap the new data at the old algorithm's ceiling — the Guo team's answer was an upgrade of mathematics itself: first, the recruitment-of-differences method (cubic interpolation) characterises the sun's non-uniformity by third-order differences — not averaging the unevenness away but carving it out precisely as a third-order structure; second, the arc-sagitta conversion turns the translation between ecliptic and equatorial arcs into computable algebra — where calendarists had mapped the two coordinates roughly, there was now an exact algorithmic skeleton; both stood at the world's mathematical frontier (the interpolation antedating Newton's cubic theory by some four centuries). Three methodological points: first, 'algorithm order' must match 'data quality' — low-order algorithms systematically distort high-order data, and high-order algorithms waste low-order data; second, the new skeleton's acceptance test is still observation — the interpolation's parameters are fixed by measured shadows, the arc coefficients by measured lengths; mathematics does not legislate for itself; third, synchronised upgrading: in a calendar-reform campaign, 'building instruments' and 'building algorithms' are two fronts of one battle, not successive phases
modes.source_chapter: 《元史·历志》载授时历'创法五事'：'用招差法，以定三差之数……用弧矢割圆术，以黄道求赤道……'
modes.key_quote_zh: 仪器升了级，算法不升级，新数据就被旧公式浪费一半——精度是仪器与算法的乘积，两头都得用力。
modes.key_quote_en: When the instrument is upgraded and the algorithm is not, half the new data is wasted by old formulas — precision is the product of instrument and algorithm; both ends must push.
key_concepts: 算法阶数匹配 algorithm-order matching（算法的阶数要与数据的结构复杂度对齐——低阶失真、高阶浪费）
algorithm-order matching (align the algorithm's order with the structural complexity of the data — too low distorts, too high wastes)
不均匀即结构 unevenness as structure（把不均匀本身建成三阶可算结构——不平均掉、不忽略，刻画之）
unevenness as structure (build the unevenness itself into a computable third-order structure — neither average it away nor ignore it; carve it)
数学受测于观测 mathematics examined by observation（插值参数与换算系数全由实测定出——数学骨架不为自己立法）
mathematics examined by observation (interpolation parameters and conversion coefficients all fixed by measurement — the skeleton does not legislate for itself)
双线同步升级 synchronised dual-front upgrading（仪器战役与算法战役同时开打——精度是乘积不是单边成绩）
synchronised dual-front upgrading (the instrument campaign and the algorithm campaign open together — precision is a product, not a one-sided score)
process_zh: 诊断失配：用当前算法跑当前数据的残差分布——残差呈系统结构（而非随机散布）即算法阶数不足的信号
升阶建模：按残差结构选择更高阶/更合适的数学骨架（插值阶数、坐标换算、统计模型）——由残差形状指导选型
以测定参：新骨架的全部自由参数由实测数据定出——数学结构可以先行，参数必须让位给观测
仪器算法再平衡：升级算法后重测仪器瓶颈——两边轮流提升直到残差只剩随机项，即匹配完成
process_en: Diagnose the mismatch: run the current data through the current algorithm and examine the residual pattern — systematic structure (not random scatter) signals too low an algorithm order
Raise the order: choose a higher/more fitting mathematical skeleton per the residual shape (interpolation order, coordinate conversion, statistical model)
Fix parameters by measurement: all free parameters of the new skeleton are determined by observed data — the mathematical structure may come first, but the parameters yield to observation
Rebalance instrument and algorithm: after the algorithm is raised, re-test the instrument's bottleneck — alternate until residuals are purely random, and the match is complete
representative_cases_zh: 招差法（三次内插）：以三阶差分刻画日行盈缩，太阳运动计算的残差降到旧历几分之一——早于牛顿同类插值理论约四百年
弧矢割圆术：以沈括会圆术为基础发展出黄赤道换算的系统算法——中国数学史上第一次球面三角的系统解法，黄经赤经赤纬的换算从此精确可算
授时历的整体精度：仪器（高表景符简仪）与算法（招差割圆）双线升级的合力——回归年 365.2425 日、节气差 2 分钟、施行 364 年，三项纪录都来自'乘积'而非单边
representative_cases_en: The recruitment-of-differences (cubic interpolation): third-order differences carving out the solar equation, residuals down to a fraction of the old calendars' — some four centuries before Newton's interpolation theory

The arc-sagitta conversion: developed from Shen Kuo's circle-dividing art into a systematic algorithm for ecliptic-equatorial translation — the first systematic spherical trigonometry in Chinese mathematics, making longitude-declination conversion exactly computable

The Shoushi's overall precision: the joint force of dual-front upgrades (instruments and algorithms) — tropical year 365.2425 days, solar terms within two minutes, 364 years in force; all three records come from the product, not one side
modern_applications_zh: 数据/算法团队的'阶数匹配'检查：模型升级前先看残差结构——系统性残差说明特征/模型阶数不足，随机残差才轮到调参
产品分析的'乘积原则'：埋点精度升级后必须同步升级分析口径——否则新数据被旧报表浪费
组织能力建设的'双线同步'：投入新工具时同步投入方法论培训——工具与用法是乘积关系，单边投入折半兑现
modern_applications_en: Order-matching checks in data/algorithm teams: before upgrading the model, examine the residual structure — systematic residuals mean the features/model order is too low; only random residuals deserve parameter tuning
The product rule for analytics: when instrumentation precision is upgraded, analysis conventions must follow — else the new data are wasted on old reports
Dual-front synchronisation in capability building: invest in methodology training whenever new tooling lands — tool and practice are a product; one-sided investment cashes out at half
representative_figures: 郭守敬（核心）
王恂（同侪参照：授时历数学体系的主要构造者——'双线升级'中的算法战线统帅）
艾萨克·牛顿（承后参照：三次插值与级数方法的独立再现——同一数学骨架在另一文明的重新发明）

modes.name_en: The Method of Renewing Along the Old Lines
modes.domain_zh: 水利与工程方法论/系统改造的默认路径不是推倒重来而是'因旧谋新'：修复西夏古渠时，他不另起炉灶，而是沿旧渠故道疏浚、在渠首建闸坝——旧系统里凝结着几代人试错得来的地形知识，全部推倒等于把学费白交；创新的正确落点在旧系统的'接口'处（闸堰），不在其'结构'处（渠道走向）；结果：十余条干渠、六十八条支渠复活，灌田九万余顷，工期与成本都远低于新建——对成熟系统做手术时，先分辨哪些是'经年验证的资产'、哪些是'亟待更换的接口'，把新东西装在接口上
modes.domain_en: Hydraulic-engineering methodology / the default path of system renovation is not demolition but 'renewing along the old lines': restoring the Tangut canals he did not start afresh — dredging the old channels and building sluice-gates at their heads; the old system embodies terrain knowledge won by generations of trial and error, and demolishing it forfeits every tuition fee paid; the correct landing point of innovation is the old system's interfaces (gates and weirs), not its structure (channel courses). Result: a dozen trunk canals and sixty-eight branches revived, ninety thousand hectares irrigated, time and cost far below new construction — when operating on a mature system, first sort what is 'time-tested asset' from 'interface awaiting renewal', and mount the new upon the interfaces
modes.definition_zh: 水利与工程方法论/1264 年的西夏：战乱使引黄古渠淤废多年——面对'从零建一套现代灌区'的诱惑，郭守敬选择'因旧谋新、更立闸堰'：旧渠的走向本身就是几十代人用洪水与淤沙换来的地形知识（为什么渠要在这里拐弯、为什么取水口设在那处河湾），推倒重来等于把这笔无价学费一次清零；他把创新预算集中在'接口'上：在每条渠首建闸坝——水的分与合、多与少由此可控，而渠道本体只需疏浚；这一区分的深层逻辑是：成熟系统的'结构'是问题的解（沉淀的智慧），系统的'接口'是时代的变量（控制的新机会）——把变量安装在解的接口上，系统既有历史的稳定性又有当下的可控性；通惠河同样是这个方法：新开的只是白浮堰引水段与二十四座闸坝，漕运的终点（积水潭）与城市的既有水系完全兼容；方法论上要求：改造前先做'资产清点'，把结构知识与接口变量分开列账，新投入全部押在接口一侧
modes.definition_en: Hydraulic-engineering methodology / the Tangut lands of 1264: war had silted up the Yellow-River canals for years — facing the temptation to 'build a modern irrigation system from zero', Guo chose 'renew along the old lines, set new gates and weirs': the old channels' courses are themselves terrain knowledge bought with generations of floods and silt (why the canal bends here, why the intake sits in that reach), and demolition would write off the tuition in one stroke; he concentrated the innovation budget on the interfaces: gates and weirs at each canal head — the parting and gathering, abundance and dearth of water thereby controlled — while the channel bodies needed only dredging. The deep logic of the distinction: a mature system's structure is the solution (sedimented wisdom), its interfaces are the era's variables (new opportunities for control) — mount the variables on the interfaces of the solution, and the system gains present-day controllability while keeping historical stability. The Tonghui Canal ran the same method: only the Baifu diversion and the twenty-four gates were new; the terminus (Jishuitan) and the city's existing waters stayed fully compatible. Methodologically: before renovation, inventory the assets, ledger the structural knowledge separately from the interface variables, and stake all new investment on the interface side
modes.source_chapter: 《元史·郭守敬传》：'因旧谋新，更立闸堰，役不逾时而渠皆通利。'
modes.key_quote_zh: 旧渠的每一次拐弯都是前人交过的学费——因旧谋新，新意装在闸口上，不是装在推倒重来上。
modes.key_quote_en: Every bend in an old canal is tuition earlier generations paid — renew along the old lines: put the new on the sluice-gates, not on the demolition.
key_concepts: 资产清点 asset inventory（改造前把'沉淀的解'与'时代的变量'分开列账——结构是解，接口是变量）
asset inventory (before renovation, ledger the sedimented solution apart from the era's variables — structure is the solution, interfaces are the variables)
接口落点 interface landing（新投入全部押在接口处——闸、堰、网关、API，控制发生在系统与时代的接缝上）
interface landing (stake all new investment at the interfaces — gates, weirs, gateways, APIs; control lives at the seam between system and era)
学费守恒 conservation of tuition（推倒成熟系统等于清零前人的试错学费——能保留的解绝不为时尚而重建）
conservation of tuition (demolishing a mature system zeroes the predecessors' trial-and-error fees — a working solution is never rebuilt for fashion)
兼容式升级 compatible upgrading（通惠河式改造：新增段与既有水系完全兼容——升级的代价由新增部分独自承担）
compatible upgrading (the Tonghui pattern: the new section fully compatible with the existing waters — the upgrade's cost borne by the addition alone)
process_zh: 清点资产：列出被改造系统的全部结构要素，标注每项的验证年限与失效风险——区分'解'与'债务'
定位接口：找出系统与外部世界交换物质/信息/控制的接缝——这些是时代变量的安装点
押注接口：新预算全部投向接口改造（闸坝/网关/协议），结构本体只做维护性疏浚
兼容验收：验收标准设为'新旧系统无缝并跑'——新增部分不得迫使既有部分改造
process_en: Inventory the assets: list every structural element of the system to be renovated, marking each one's years of validation and failure risk — sort the solution from the debt
Locate the interfaces: find the seams where the system exchanges matter, information and control with the world — the mounting points of the era's variables
Stake the interfaces: direct the whole new budget to interface works (gates, weirs, gateways, protocols); the structure itself receives maintenance dredging only
Accept by compatibility: the acceptance test is 'new and old running seamlessly together' — the addition must never force the existing parts to change
representative_cases_zh: 西夏治水（1264）：'因旧谋新、更立闸堰'——十余条古渠、六十八条支渠疏浚复通，渠首新设闸坝使分水可控，'役不逾时而渠皆通利'，灌田九万余顷
金口河的减水口：重开金口河引浑河运建材时预开减水口以分洪——接口上的一个前瞻装置让引水与防洪不再互斥，河道安全使用近三十年
通惠河（1291-1293）：新开白浮堰引水段与二十四座闸坝斗门，漕船直达积水潭——大都既有水系与城市格局一字未改，改造的全部创新装在接口上
representative_cases_en: The Tangut restoration (1264): 'renew along the old lines, set new gates and weirs' — a dozen ancient canals and sixty-eight branches dredged open, new head-works making the parting of water controllable, 'the works not outlasting a season yet every canal flowing', ninety thousand hectares irrigated

The Jinzhou Canal's spillway: reopening the canal to raft building-materials, he pre-cut a spillway to divide floods — one forward device at the interface made diversion and flood-control no longer mutually exclusive, the channel serving nearly thirty years in safety

The Tonghui Canal (1291-1293): the new Baifu diversion and twenty-four gates and weirs brought grain barges straight to Jishuitan — Dadu's existing waters and urban fabric untouched; all the innovation mounted on the interfaces
modern_applications_zh: 遗留系统现代化的'绞杀式改造'：不推倒重写，新功能以适配器/网关形态接在旧系统接口上——旧结构继续还债，新接口逐步接管
组织变革的'接口层改革'：不动核心业务流程（沉淀的解），改决策接口（审批链、信息流）——变革阻力最小而控制力增量最大
并购整合的'资产清点'：先分清标的公司的'解'（客户关系、工艺积累）与'债务'（过时流程），新投入只押在财务与数据接口
modern_applications_en: Strangler-style modernisation of legacy systems: not a rewrite but new functions mounted as adapters/gateways on the old interfaces — the old structure keeps serving while new interfaces take over step by step

Interface-layer reform in organisational change: leave the core business process (the sedimented solution) untouched; change the decision interfaces (approval chains, information flows) — least resistance, greatest gain in control

Asset inventory in M&A integration: first sort the target's solution (client relations, craft accumulation) from its debt (obsolete processes); stake new investment only on the financial and data interfaces
representative_figures: 郭守敬（核心）
李冰（承前参照：都江堰'因势利导'——同一'结构是解'智慧的水利源头）
奥托·冯·俾斯麦（跨域参照：以既有制度为结构、只在接口处立法——'因旧谋新'的政治版本）

modes.name_en: The Method of the Detoured Source
modes.domain_zh: 复杂系统方法论/当直接路径被地形与权力双重封死时，把'最短路径'目标替换为'最长可行路径'：通惠河的水源难题——白浮泉在城西北，直线引水必经沙河与清河河谷（水将半路渗失），且需穿越皇家陵园（政治上不可行）——郭守敬的解法是让泉水先向西再向南，绕行瓮山泊，多走数十里'错路'，换来全程水位自流下降、一滴不渗、一路避开禁区；表面上'舍近求远'，实质是识别出约束条件下'直线'根本不是解——约束求解的第一课：先确认目标函数写对了（可行>最短），再谈优化
modes.domain_en: Complex-systems methodology / when the direct path is closed by terrain and power at once, replace the goal of 'shortest path' with 'longest feasible path': the Tonghui Canal's water-source problem — the Baifu spring lay northwest of the city; a straight-line aqueduct would cross the Sha and Qing river valleys (the water seeping away halfway) and pass through the imperial tombs (politically impossible); Guo's solution: let the spring first run west, then south, rounding Kunming Lake, travelling dozens of li of 'wrong way' in exchange for a gravity-flowing, non-seeping, taboo-avoiding course the whole way. On its face 'trading the near for the far'; in substance the recognition that under the constraints a straight line is no solution at all — the first lesson of constrained optimisation: confirm the objective function is written correctly (feasible over shortest) before optimising anything
modes.definition_zh: 复杂系统方法论/1291 年的通惠河水源问题是一道被三重约束封死的题：水量约束（必须找到稳定泉源）、地形约束（沙河清河河谷会渗失水量）、政治约束（线路不得穿越皇家陵区）——在'最短引水线'的目标函数下此题无解；郭守敬的破题是改写目标函数本身：不是'引最短的水路'，而是'引全程自流且不渗不失不犯禁的水路'——白浮泉先被引向西（背离目的地），汇入瓮山泊抬高与澄清，再沿西山山麓等高线南下，最后从和义门入城；多走的数十里不是成本而是收益：等高线绕行保证了全程重力自流（无泵时代唯一可靠的'泵'是地势），瓮山泊充当了天然沉沙池与调节水库，绕行线路恰好避开了两处河谷渗失带与全部禁区；方法论要点有三：其一，约束变化时先重写目标函数——'可行'是比'最短'高一级的目标；其二，迂回不是妥协而是利用——绕行的每一里都要换来一样直接路径给不了的东西（自流、澄清、避禁）；其三，画路线前先画约束地图——地形、水量、权力三张图叠起来，解的空间自己显形
modes.definition_en: Complex-systems methodology / the water-source problem of the Tonghui Canal (1291) was a question sealed by three constraints: volume (a stable spring had to be found), terrain (the Sha and Qing valleys would drink the flow), politics (no line might cross the imperial tombs) — under the objective 'shortest aqueduct' it had no solution; Guo broke it by rewriting the objective itself: not 'the shortest water-route' but 'a route gravity-flowing the whole way, seeping nothing, losing nothing, trespassing nowhere' — the Baifu spring first led west (away from its destination), gathered and clarified in Kunming Lake, then followed the contour lines along the western hills' foot southward, entering the city at Hemen. The dozens of extra li were not cost but yield: contour-following guaranteed gravity flow the whole way (in a pumpless age, the only reliable pump is the land itself), Kunming Lake served as settling basin and regulating reservoir, and the detour skirted both seepage belts and every taboo. Three methodological points: first, when constraints change, rewrite the objective — 'feasible' is a level above 'shortest'; second, the detour is not compromise but exploitation — every extra li must purchase something the straight line cannot give (gravity, clarity, taboo-avoidance); third, draw the constraint map before the route map — stack terrain, water and power, and the space of solutions reveals itself
modes.source_chapter: 《元史·郭守敬传》：'别引白浮泉，西折而南，经瓮山泊，自西水门入城，环汇于积水潭。'
modes.key_quote_zh: 路走不通时先查目标函数——'最短'写错了，'可行'才是题目本意；多绕的每一里，都要换来直线给不了的东西。
modes.key_quote_en: When the road will not open, audit the objective first — 'shortest' was written wrong; 'feasible' is what the question meant. Every extra li of detour must buy what the straight line cannot.
key_concepts: 目标函数重写 objective rewriting（约束封死题目时先怀疑目标函数——'可行'高于'最短'）
objective rewriting (when constraints seal the question, suspect the objective first — feasible outranks shortest)
迂回即利用 detour as exploitation（绕行不是妥协而是交易——每一里迂回必须兑换成自流/澄清/避禁等直接路径给不了的收益）
detour as exploitation (the detour is not compromise but trade — every extra li must cash into gravity, clarity, or taboo-avoidance)
等高线思维 contour thinking（无泵时代以地势为泵——让路径贴着等高线走，重力替工程做工）
contour thinking (in a pumpless age the land is the pump — run the path along the contours and let gravity do the work)
约束地图先行 constraint map first（地形、资源、权力三张约束图叠加之后，可行解的空间自己显形）
constraint map first (stack the maps of terrain, resources and power, and the space of feasible solutions reveals itself)
process_zh: 叠约束地图：把物理约束、资源约束、权力/合规约束分别画成图后叠加——标出全部禁区与渗失带
重写目标函数：确认题目真正要的是'可行'还是'最短'——在硬约束存在时把可行写成第一目标
设计有收益的迂回：任何偏离直线的路径段都必须兑换出明确收益（自流/澄清/避禁）——纯绕路不算解
以自然力为引擎：优先让地势/重力/既有水库做工——人工干预（泵、闸）只补自然力够不着的最后一段
process_en: Stack the constraint maps: draw physical, resource, and power/compliance constraints separately, then overlay — marking every taboo zone and seepage belt
Rewrite the objective: confirm whether the question truly wants 'feasible' or 'shortest' — under hard constraints, feasibility is written as the first objective
Design profitable detours: every path segment off the straight line must cash out a clear yield (gravity, clarity, taboo-avoidance) — pure wandering is no solution
Let nature power the engine: first make terrain, gravity and existing reservoirs do the work — artificial intervention (pumps, gates) only covers the last stretch nature cannot reach
representative_cases_zh: 通惠河引水线（1291）：白浮泉'西折而南'绕瓮山泊入城——多走数十里换来全程自流、天然沉沙、避开沙清河谷渗失带与皇家禁区，漕运水源问题一次解死
白浮堰长堤：沿引水线东岸筑堤防渗——与迂回线路配套的'每一里都要守住水'的工程兜底
积水潭终点设计：入城段与大都既有水系兼容汇流——迂回解法并不豁免'因旧谋新'：终点仍接在旧系统的接口上
representative_cases_en: The Tonghui diversion line (1291): the Baifu spring 'led west, then south' around Kunming Lake into the city — dozens of extra li exchanged for gravity flow throughout, natural settling, and clearance of both seepage belts and imperial taboo, sealing the canal's water problem in one stroke
The Baifu embankment: a long dike along the east bank of the diversion line against seepage — the engineering backstop to the detour: every li must hold its water

The Jishuitan terminus: the city-entering section joined and pooled with Dadu's existing waters — the detour does not exempt one from 'renewing along the old lines': the terminus still lands on the old system's interface
modern_applications_zh: 系统架构的'可行优先'：数据合规或网络封锁使直线方案不可行时，先重写目标函数（可行>最短）再设计迂回架构（绕行中间层）
职业与商业路径的'迂回变现'：禁区（行业管制、牌照）使直线不可行时，绕行每一站都要有明确收益（资质、客群、技能）——纯绕路是漂泊
谈判与博弈的'约束地图'：开局前叠好利益约束、法律约束与关系约束三张图——可行协议的空间往往在'错方向'的让步里
modern_applications_en: Feasibility-first in system architecture: when compliance or network封锁 makes the direct design impossible, rewrite the objective (feasible over shortest) before designing the detoured architecture (interposed layers)

Detours that pay in careers and business: when taboos (regulation, licensing) close the straight path, every waystation of the detour must cash a clear yield (credentials, clientele, skills) — wandering without yield is drift
The constraint map in negotiation: before opening, stack the maps of interest, law and relationship — the space of feasible agreements often lies in concessions toward the 'wrong' direction
representative_figures: 郭守敬（核心）
李冰（承前参照：都江堰以鱼嘴分水、宝瓶口控流——以地形为引擎的先行者）
汉尼拔（跨域参照：以绕行阿尔卑斯的'错路'换战略突然性——迂回即利用的军事版本）

modes.name_en: The Method of Governing by Gates
modes.domain_zh: 系统工程方法论/落差既是动力又是敌人——通惠河全线落差大，水急则漕船毁、水缓则河淤：郭守敬的解法不是选边（要动力还是要平稳），而是把连续的落差离散化为二十四座闸坝、分级分段管理——每一级内部水势平缓，级与级之间由闸坝交接；'把不可控的大梯度切成可控的小梯度'，是流量、风险与变革管理的通用结构：不与梯度对抗，也不假装梯度不存在，而是给它装上手柄
modes.domain_en: Systems-engineering methodology / a gradient is both engine and enemy — the Tonghui's fall was great along its whole line: swift water wrecked barges, slow water silted the channel; Guo's answer took no side (power or smoothness) but discretised the continuous gradient into twenty-four gates, governing by tiers — within each tier the water is calm; between tiers, gates hand it over. 'Cut an uncontrollable large gradient into controllable small ones' is a universal structure for flow, risk and change management: neither fight the gradient nor pretend it away — fit it with handles
modes.definition_zh: 系统工程方法论/把泉水从西山引到积水潭，全线落差数十米——若一泻到底，急流冲毁河道；若全面蓄水，缓流淤塞河床；郭守敬的方案是把连续落差'离散化'：沿河设闸坝、斗门二十四座，河被切成二十余个平缓的梯级——船至闸前，闭闸蓄水，水位齐平即开闸放行；闸坝是落差的手柄：它不消除落差（落差是使漕运可能的动力），而把落差从'不可控的整体'变成'可逐级交接的序列'；这背后是一个普适的工程-管理原理：大梯度系统（大风险、大变革、大流量）的直接失控风险与梯度成正比，而控制手段是离散化——把连续的大落差切成带手柄的小落差；更深一层，闸坝的节律本身就是管理：'船到闸前先蓄水'意味着系统必须为每一次交接预留缓冲（蓄水时间）——速度的代价由缓冲支付，而不是由稳定性支付；方法论上要求：识别系统的天然梯度，为它设计梯级结构，在每一级交接处装上'闭-蓄-开'的仪式
modes.definition_en: Systems-engineering methodology / to lead the spring water from the western hills to Jishuitan the line falls dozens of metres — one rush would tear the channel open, full ponding would silt it shut; Guo's scheme discretised the continuous gradient: twenty-four gates and weirs cut the river into twenty-odd calm tiers — a barge arrives at a gate, the gate closes, water ponds until level, the gate opens and it passes on. The gate is the gradient's handle: it does not abolish the fall (the fall is the very power that makes canal transport possible) but turns the fall from an uncontrollable whole into a sequence of tier-by-tier handovers. Behind this lies a universal engineering-and-management principle: in a large-gradient system (great risk, great change, great flow), the risk of losing control scales with the gradient, and the instrument of control is discretisation — cutting one big continuous fall into handled small falls. Deeper still, the gates' rhythm is itself governance: 'pond before passing' means the system reserves a buffer for every handover (the time of ponding) — speed's price is paid by the buffer, never by stability. Methodologically: identify the system's natural gradient, design its tiered structure, and install the close-pond-open rite at every handover
modes.source_chapter: 《元史·郭守敬传》载通惠河'置闸坝，凡二十四'，'船既通行，公私便之'
modes.key_quote_zh: 落差不要消灭，要装上手柄——把一整段不可控的陡，切成二十四个可交接的缓，速度的代价由缓冲付，不由稳定付。
modes.key_quote_en: Do not abolish the gradient; fit it with handles — cut one uncontrollable steep into twenty-four handover-able calms, and let speed's price be paid by buffers, never by stability.
key_concepts: 梯度离散化 gradient discretisation（把连续大落差切成逐级小落差——每一级内部平缓，交接处可控）
gradient discretisation (cut the continuous large fall into tiered small falls — calm within each tier, controlled at every handover)
手柄原则 the handle principle（不消除动力也不假装无动力——给不可控量装上可操作的交接装置）
the handle principle (neither abolish the power nor feign its absence — fit the uncontrollable quantity with operable handover devices)
缓冲付费 buffers pay for speed（每一次交接预留蓄水/等待的缓冲——速度的代价由缓冲承担而非由稳定性承担）
buffers pay for speed (reserve ponding/waiting buffers at every handover — speed's cost borne by buffers, never by stability)
交接仪式 the handover rite（闭-蓄-开的固定程序让每一级交接可重复可审计——节律本身是管理）
the handover rite (the fixed close-pond-open sequence makes every handover repeatable and auditable — the rhythm itself is governance)
process_zh: 测绘天然梯度：把系统的落差/风险/变革幅度沿全程测绘出来——标出最陡段
设计梯级：按'每一级内部可控'的原则切分梯度——梯级数由最陡段决定，不由平均值决定
装手柄：在每级交接处设'闸'（审批点/缓冲池/检查站）——交接必须有固定程序与明确责任
以缓冲养速度：为每道闸预留蓄水时间——宁可慢在闸前，不可毁在级内
process_en: Survey the natural gradient: map the system's fall/risk/change magnitude along its whole course — mark the steepest reaches
Design the tiers: cut the gradient so each tier is controllable within itself — the number of tiers is set by the steepest reach, never by the average
Fit the handles: place a 'gate' (approval point, buffer pool, checkpoint) at every tier handover — each handover has a fixed procedure and a named owner
Let buffers buy speed: reserve ponding time at every gate — better slow before the gate than wrecked inside the tier
representative_cases_zh: 通惠河二十四闸：把数十米落差切成二十余个梯级，'船至闸前闭闸蓄水，水平开闸放行'——江南漕船直达大都，'公私便之'；这是中国古代最大规模的梯级化管理工程
白浮堰与闸坝的配套：引水段（水源迂回）与行船段（梯级管理）两套结构各司其职——上游不慌、下游不淤的分工
铁幡竿渠的反例：施工者擅自更改郭守敬的设计（据载削减了关键控制结构），渠成即被大水冲毁——抽掉梯级与手柄的梯度系统必然回归失控
representative_cases_en: The Tonghui's twenty-four gates: dozens of metres of fall cut into twenty-odd tiers — 'a barge arrives, the gate closes, the water ponds, level, the gate opens, it passes'; grain barges from the south reached Dadu directly, 'to public and private alike a convenience'; the largest tiered-management work of ancient China

The Baifu embankment paired with the gates: the diversion section (detoured source) and the barge section (tiered gradient) as two structures, each to its duty — the headwaters calm, the downstream unsilted

The Tiebanquan counter-case: the builders altered Guo's design (cutting, the record says, its key control structures), and the finished channel was destroyed by flood — a gradient system stripped of tiers and handles reverts to loss of control
modern_applications_zh: 发布管理的'梯级上线'：大版本不一次放量——按风险梯度切成灰度梯级，每级设回滚闸（手柄）与观察缓冲
组织变革的'闸坝节奏'：大转型不搞一刀切——按部门/业务线设梯级，每级交接设审批点与缓冲期，速度的代价由缓冲付
个人财务的'落差离散化'：大额支出决策不直落——设'闭闸（冷静期）-蓄水（准备金到位）-开闸（支付）'三步
modern_applications_en: Tiered rollouts in release management: never release a major version in one gush — cut it into canary tiers by risk gradient, each with a rollback gate (the handle) and an observation buffer
Gate-rhythm in organisational change: no big-bang transformation — tier by business line, an approval point and a buffer period at every handover, speed's price paid by buffers
Gradient discretisation in personal finance: no falling straight into a large outlay — the three steps of close-gate (cooling period), pond (reserve funded), open-gate (payment)

modes.name_en: The Method of the Sea as Datum
modes.domain_zh: 测量学方法论/比较两个'高'之前，先问'相对什么而言'：郭守敬'尝以海面较京师至汴梁地形高下之差'——用海平面做统一基准面来比较两地高下，这是世界测量史上第一次有记载的高程基准概念（'海拔'的先声）；在此之前，'高'只是相对于邻地的'高'，两地的高不可比；他的洞见是：任何比较都需要一个第三方基准，而最好的第三方基准是一个处处可达且处处同一的自然面——海洋；方法论上这是'基准革命'的模板：当争论双方各执一词时，不要在双方之间裁决，去寻找（或发明）那个让双方都可通约的外部基准
modes.domain_en: Measurement methodology / before comparing two 'heights', ask 'relative to what': Guo 'once compared the height-difference between the capital and Bianliang against the sea surface' — taking sea level as one unified datum for comparing elevations, the first recorded sea-level datum in the history of surveying (the forerunner of 'altitude above sea level'); before this, 'high' meant only 'high relative to the neighbourhood', and the heights of two places were incomparable; his insight: every comparison needs a third-party datum, and the best is a natural surface reachable everywhere and identical everywhere — the sea. Methodologically this is the template of the 'datum revolution': when two sides of a dispute each hold their own ground, do not adjudicate between them — seek (or invent) the external datum that makes them commensurable
modes.definition_zh: 测量学方法论/大都与汴梁谁高谁低，在没有统一基准的时代是个各自表述的问题——以本地河面为尺，两地各有各的'高'；郭守敬引入海面作为第三方基准：海洋是一个处处可达（凡有水系相连处皆可推算）、处处同一（海面本身是物理上统一的等势面）的自然基准——两地'高'从此有了同一个参照系，'海拔'概念由此发端；这一步的深层意义在于方法论：争议双方（大都的高与汴梁的高）不需要任何一方认输，只需要一个让双方可通约的第三者——而最好的第三者是那种'处处可达且处处同一'的存在：海面对空间是这样，对时间是这样（原子钟之于时刻），对观点也是这样（可重复的实验之于假说）；方法论上要求：每当两个量无法比较时，先诊断'缺的不是测量而是基准'——去寻找或发明那个统一的第三者，而不是把力气花在让一方压倒另一方
modes.definition_en: Measurement methodology / whether Dadu or Bianliang stood higher was, in an age without a unified datum, a matter of each speaking its own terms — measured against the local river, each place had its own 'high'; Guo introduced the sea surface as a third-party datum: the ocean is reachable everywhere (computable wherever waters connect) and identical everywhere (the sea surface is physically one equipotential face) — from then on the two 'heights' shared one reference frame, and the concept of elevation above sea level was born. The deeper import is methodological: the two disputing parties (Dadu's height and Bianliang's) need not concede anything to each other; they need only a third party that makes them commensurable — and the best third party is what is 'reachable everywhere and identical everywhere': the sea for space, the atomic clock for time, the replicable experiment for hypotheses. Methodologically: whenever two quantities refuse comparison, first diagnose that 'what is missing is not measurement but a datum' — seek or invent the unifying third party, rather than spending force making one side crush the other
modes.source_chapter: 《元朝名臣事略》引郭守敬事迹：'又尝以海面较京师至汴梁地形高下之差'——世界测量史上最早的高程基准记载
modes.key_quote_zh: 两个'高'吵不出高下，直到海面来了——最好的裁决者不是更强的论点，而是那个处处可达、处处同一的第三者。
modes.key_quote_en: Two 'heights' argue their case forever, until the sea arrives — the finest arbiter is not the stronger argument but the third party reachable everywhere and identical everywhere.
key_concepts: 第三方基准 the third-party datum（一切比较需要统一参照系——缺的不是测量而是基准）
the third-party datum (all comparison needs one reference frame — what is missing is not measurement but a datum)
处处同一 identically everywhere（合格基准的双重标准：处处可达且处处同一——海面/原子钟/可重复实验）
identically everywhere (a qualified datum is both reachable everywhere and identical everywhere — sea, atomic clock, replicable experiment)
通约先于裁决 commensurability before adjudication（让双方可通约优先于让一方获胜——基准革命不动任何一方的立场）
commensurability before adjudication (make the parties commensurable before making one win — the datum revolution displaces no one's position)
基准即基础设施 datum as infrastructure（统一基准是所有下游测量的公共品——先修基准，后修测量）
datum as infrastructure (a unified datum is the public good beneath all downstream measurement — build the datum before the measurements)
process_zh: 诊断比较失败：当两个量无法比较时，先判断缺的是测量精度还是统一基准——基准缺失的标志是'各自表述'
寻找自然基准：搜索'处处可达且处处同一'的存在作为第三方——物理等势面、标准单位、可重复程序
迁移双方：把争议双方都改挂到新基准上——不动任何一方的立场，只动参照系
制度化基准：把基准写进规范与流程——此后所有测量自动继承通约性，基准成为公共基础设施
process_en: Diagnose the failed comparison: when two quantities refuse comparison, judge whether measurement precision or a unified datum is missing — 'each speaking its own terms' is the signature of a missing datum
Seek the natural datum: search for something 'reachable everywhere, identical everywhere' as the third party — physical equipotentials, standard units, replicable procedures
Migrate both parties: re-attach both sides of the dispute to the new datum — moving no one's position, only the reference frame
Institutionalise the datum: write the datum into standards and process — all downstream measurement inherits commensurability, and the datum becomes public infrastructure
representative_cases_zh: 以海面较大都与汴梁高下：世界测量史上第一次有记载的高程基准应用——'海拔'概念的先声，两地之'高'从此可通约
授时历的时间基准：废上元、截近元——在时间轴上执行同一逻辑：以'当下的观测'作为统一基准，取代'虚构的远古起点'
四海测验的仪器统一：空间测量上同样先统一基准（仪器与口径）再展开测量——基准先行，测量随后，是郭守敬一切工程的总顺序
representative_cases_en: Comparing Dadu and Bianliang against the sea: the first recorded use of a height datum in the history of surveying — the forerunner of 'altitude above sea level', making the two places' heights commensurable at last

The Shoushi's temporal datum: abolishing the grand epoch and taking a recent one — the same logic executed on the time axis: the present observation as unified datum, displacing a fictitious ancient origin

Unified instruments in the Four Seas Survey: in spatial measurement likewise, the datum (instrument and convention) unified before the measuring began — datum first, measurement after: the master order of all Guo's works
modern_applications_zh: 跨部门指标之争的'基准工程'：两个部门'各自表述'时，不裁输赢而是共建统一口径（第三方数据源/统一定义）——通约先于裁决
标准与协议的公共品思维：先建行业标准（基准），再竞争产品（测量）——基准制定者获得整个下游的通约权
国际比较的'购买力平价'式基准：比较两国经济不比较名义值，先构造统一购买力基准——基准错则比较全错
modern_applications_en: Datum engineering in cross-team metric disputes: when two departments speak their own terms, do not adjudicate — co-build one convention (third-party source, unified definition); commensurability before adjudication

Public-good thinking in standards and protocols: set the industry standard (the datum) before competing on products (the measurements) — the datum's author owns the commensurability of the whole downstream
PPP-style datums in international comparison: do not compare two economies on nominal values; construct one purchasing-power datum first — a wrong datum spoils every comparison built on it
